main_text.p: גרם Ch. In caussa esse, Caussari, Caussam praebere: Item Conterere, comminuere; Unde Infinit. Pahel לגרמא Ad comminuendum, Psal.27.2. Item Roborari, fortificari, ut ברחמותא תגרם In amore roboraberis, Proverb.5.19. Item Syr. Perficere, Consummare, idem quod גמר, ad Rom. 9. 28. in Regiis.
Exemplar Viennense habet ꝏ, quod Tremelius retinet, ac vertit, Decidit. Aphel Praet. כר אנרים Cum roboraret, Prov.8.28.
גרמא גרם Ch. & Syr. Os, Ofsis, a robore. Deinde sumitur quoque ut Hebraeum עצם pro Ipsemet. Plural. גרמיא, גרמין, גרמיא: Syr. ܓܪܡܐ.
גרמידא Ch. Cubitus, Brachium, Exod.2.5.in Jon. Judic.3.16. Hebr. גמר.
גרס Ch. Frangi, Comminui: Item Legere, Discere, Studere. Pahel Infin. למגרסא בהון Ut studeant in eis, Deut.11.19. in Jonath.
גירסא Ch. Lectio, doctrina, studium, explicatio, Cantic.1.2. Translat. Germ. Judaeorum, Die Gemara mit ihrem pilpul/i.e. Gemara cum suis disputationibus. Gemara est explicatio textus Talmud.

גרע Ch. Minuere, diminuere, imminuere: Syr. specialiter Diminuere, radere, abradere capillos, Act.21.24. 1.ad Cor. 11.6. ܓܪܥ Cujus caput rasum est, v.5. Sic in Targum: וגרעת ית שבע גרילת ורישיה Et abrasit septe cincinos capitis ejus, Jud.16.19.

page.notes: Hebrew, Greek and Syriac words are reproduced approximately; several Hebrew/Syriac forms with marginal marks and handwritten-looking tittles are uncertain. The final "גרף" stands alone at the foot right as a catchword-like entry; the cursive marks on some lines are doubtful.
